name: UBC Medical Indonesia Tbk.
summary: UBC Medical Indonesia Tbk (LABS.JK) serves as a key supplier of medical devices throughout Indonesia. The company's operations are structured into two primary divisions: Medical Disposables and Consumables, and Diagnostics and Equipment. Its comprehensive product lineup includes advanced solutions for next-generation molecular analysis, AI-driven retina diagnostics, infectious disease detection, HPV DNA testing, real-time PCR technology, TB management systems, and newborn screening. Established in 2014, UBC Medical Indonesia Tbk is headquartered in Jakarta Timur, Jakarta, and operates as a subsidiary under the ownership of PT Optel Investama Mulia.
